sets.relationshipLabel: a container and the small thing kept in it
sets.explanation: A jar holds a loose button and a spool holds wound thread — each pair names a keeper and the small item it stores.

sets.relationshipLabel: the tool that lets the other tool/thing work
sets.explanation: A thimble lets you push a needle safely, just as a buttonhook lets you fasten a boot — the first tool exists to enable the second.

sets.relationshipLabel: the earlier and later state of decline
sets.explanation: Loose leads to missing and new leads to outgrown — each pair tracks an intact state sliding into a diminished one.

sets.relationshipLabel: a fastener and the one feature it can never have
sets.explanation: A snap never has a buttonhole and a zipper never has a shank — each fastener is defined partly by the closure feature it structurally lacks.

glossary.definition: An old-fashioned little tool with a hooked end, used long ago for pulling small fasteners through tight openings on clothing.
